lines.trans: It turned out somewhat awkward, Kostya.
You almost broke my nose!
Old buddy, forgive me, please!
What good is your simple apology to me?
Now you owe me big time.
What can I do for you?
Make me some fresh orange juice.
My head is spinning very much.
I will do everything quickly right now.
It is very loud in the kitchen right now.
Is the chef shouting at the cooks again?
He is still looking for the knife.
Then it is better for us to be quieter.
Hold your juice, my friend.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

meanings.note: imperative держи! when handing something over

examples.trans: Here you go, this is for you.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: в долгу не остаться = to repay a favour

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

злить.gloss: to anger, to irritate, to infuriate

examples.trans: Do not anger the chef today.

meanings.note: голова кружится = one's head is spinning, one feels dizzy

examples.trans: The leaves are whirling in the wind.
